shell.description: Meet Amanda Hecimovic, Registered Clinical Counsellor, and learn about the kind of therapeutic relationship clients can expect.

intro.title: A steady place to make sense of what you are carrying
paragraphs: Hi, I’m Amanda. I’m a Registered Clinical Counsellor (license #29097) with the British Columbia Association of Clinical Counsellors.

My work primarily focuses on eating disorder recovery and disordered eating, including anorexia, bulimia, orthorexia, binge eating, and body image concerns. I view eating disorders and disordered eating as ways people may have learned to cope with overwhelming experiences. Other factors in our lives can contribute to, maintain, and intensify challenges with eating and body image.

Anxiety, depression, burnout, struggles with self-worth, trauma, interpersonal relationship challenges, and life transitions are some common experiences that can have a significant impact on someone living with an eating disorder or disordered eating’s mental health.

That’s why, when we work together, we’ll explore your relationship to food and your body, while also looking at other areas of your life that may be impacting your recovery. We will work to understand what the eating disorder/disordered eating may be helping you cope with, while developing new coping strategies and skills to help you turn towards the eating disorder or disordered eating less and build a life that feels more fulfilling and aligned with who you are.

values.title: Therapeutic approach
values.description: Counselling here is collaborative and practical, drawing on person-centred, trauma-informed, and CBT-informed ideas as they fit your goals.

items.title: Collaborative care
items.description: Counselling works best when goals, pace, and focus are shaped together.

items.title: Respect for lived experience
items.description: You bring wisdom about your own life, identities, relationships, and needs.

items.title: Practical support
items.description: Sessions can include reflection, skill-building, nervous system support, and clear next steps.
